凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。
CURRENT SCENE:
糟糕，这黄色的花是夹竹桃，特别是毒。正好在这儿，灵芝药的夹竹桃他吃完了，也写一个课文的植物。谢谢神农。

  her past correction (example_emphasis_connectors): 夹竹桃[是特别是毒→的毒特别厉害] — her note: ”特别是+N, + Clause” is used to single out a typical example
  her past correction (addition_repetition_connectors): [-还]有的有毒
  rule card word_class_choice: Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard. Not an error: Do not flag 文明 when it is used as an Adj. meaning “civilized.”
  rule card example_emphasis_connectors: 比方说 introduces a following example; delete it when no example follows. 特别是+N, + Clause singles out a typical example, so N must be an example of the category. Not an error: Do not flag 比方说 when it is followed by an actual example. Do not flag 特别是 when it has the 特别是+N, + Clause pattern and N is a typical example of the category.

[P205] 【灵芝药的夹竹桃】他吃完了

  rule card verb_object_valency: Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself.
